data.name: Mulchand
data.gender_notes: Mulchand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mul meaning mill or wheel, and Chand meaning lord or master. This name is derived from the Hindu god Mulnath, who is the deity of mills and agriculture. The name Mulchand carries the meaning “Lord of the Mill” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mulchand usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes hard work, perseverance, and prosperity.
data.etymology: Mulchand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Mill.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mulchand total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Mulchand holds significant importance in the agricultural community as his name is derived from Mulnath, the deity of mills and agriculture in Hinduism. He is esteemed and revered as the patron god of the farming community in various regions, particularly in Gujarat and Maharashtra where the name is most commonly found. The faith in Mulchand is reflected through prayers, rituals, and cultural traditions dedicated to him.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mulchand symbolizes the divine power and connection to the agricultural cycle. It represents the idea of God as the ultimate master over nature and human endeavors. For Hindus, the name serves as a reminder of the spiritual significance of working the land and reaping its bounty. Mulchand is invoked for prosperity, abundance, and protection from natural elements that impact agricultural production. The name also underscores the fundamental belief in karma, the continuous cycle of cause and effect, where the behavior of an individual influences the outcome of their work and life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mulchand: Rooted in the divine (Mul), limitless consciousness (Chand). This name signifies a strong connection to the divine source, and an understanding that true consciousness transcends all limitations.
